Ireland

Day1

Arrive Dublin/Galway

  • Upon arrival at Dublin Airport you will be welcomed by your driver and guide for the transfer to Galway

  • Travel through the central plain of Ireland towards Galway

  • Explore the vibrant city of Galway and its colourful streets filled with music, dance and art

  • Dinner and Overnight At your First Class Hotel accommodation in Galway

Connacht Hotel or similar

Day2

Aran Islands

  • Full Irish Breakfast at the hotel

  • Full Day Excursion to the Aran Islands

  • Travel by boat from Rossaveel to Inishmore, discovering its ancient stone landscapes, historic sites, and authentic island charm

  • Lunch at Joe Watty’s Irish Pub

  • Minibus tour of the island to experience the history in real time

  • Visit the pre-historic hill fort of Dun Aonghasa located on a 300 ft high cliff

  • Return to Rossaveel via boat

  • Dinner and Overnight At your First Class Hotel accommodation in Galway

Connacht Hotel or similar

Day3

Connemara – Kylemore Abbey

  • Full Irish Breakfast at the hotel

  • Full Day Excursion of Connemara

  • Travel through the scenic Connemara landscape, passing Leenane, Killary Fjord, the Twelve Bens Mountains, and the region’s iconic boglands

  • Visit Kylemore Abbey, a historic lakeside castle featuring restored rooms, a Neo-Gothic church, and beautiful Victorian walled gardens

  • Return to Galway through the rugged Connemara countryside

  • Dinner and Overnight At your First Class Hotel accommodation in Galway

Connacht Hotel or similar

Day4

Clare – Dublin

  • Full Irish Breakfast at the hotel

  • Bid farewell to Galway and explore the historical county Clare

  • Travel southwards along the shores of Galway Bay to Co Clare

  • Explore the majestic landscape of The Burren with its lunar like appearance

  • Visit the iconic Cliffs of Moher, rising 600 feet above the Atlantic and offering spectacular coastal views from O’Brien’s Tower

  • A visit is included to the Atlantic Edge Visitor Centre

  • Drive through Co Clare in the direction of Ennis and travel eastwards to Dublin

  • Dinner and Overnight at your First Class Hotel in Dublin

Academy Plaza Hotel or similar

Day5

Dublin

  • Full Irish Breakfast at the hotel

  • Enjoy a panoramic tour of Dublin

  • Visit Ireland’s oldest university, Trinity College, founded in 1592 by Elizabeth I, and view the famous Book of Kells in the historic library

  • Explore the Guinness Storehouse, discovering seven floors of brewing history and enjoying a pint with panoramic views from the Gravity Bar

  • Free time in the afternoon around the Capital City

  • Enjoy an Irish Night with dinner, traditional Irish music and dancing

  • Overnight at your First Class Hotel in Dublin

Academy Plaza Hotel or similar

Day6

Dublin – Keflavík Airport

  • Full Irish Breakfast at the hotel

  • Transfer to Dublin Airport for your flight to Keflavík International Airport

  • Upon arrival at Keflavík International Airport you will be welcomed by your driver and guide for the transfer to Reykjavík

  • Discover Iceland’s highlights with your guide along the journey

  • After checking in to your hotel enjoy free time to explore Reykjavík at your own pace

  • Discover the city centre, visit local landmarks, or relax in one of Reykjavík’s cafés or restaurants

  • Dinner and Overnight At your First Class Hotel accommodation with a welcome dinner in a Reykjavík hotel

Fosshotel Lind or similar

Day7

The Golden Circle

  • Breakfast at the hotel

  • Discover Iceland’s famous Golden Circle route

  • Enjoy a short sightseeing tour of Reykjavík

  • Explore Þingvellir National Park, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, and walk between the North American and Eurasian tectonic plates

  • Visit Friðheimar Farm to see geothermal greenhouses and meet the Icelandic horse

  • Experience Gullfoss (Golden Falls), one of Iceland’s most spectacular waterfalls

  • Dinner and Overnight At your First-Class picturesque Hotel accommodation in South Iceland

Stracta Hotel or similar

Day8

Fjaðrárgljúfur Canyon & Diamond Beach

  • Breakfast at the hotel

  • Travel along Iceland’s breathtaking South Coast towards Vatnajökull National Park

  • Along the way stop at Fjaðrárgljúfur Canyon and the scenic Skaftafell area en route to Jökulsárlón Glacier Lagoon

  • Enjoy an amphibian boat tour among the floating icebergs and look out for seals

  • Visit Diamond Beach and experience the breathtaking landscapes of Vatnajökull National Park, home to Europe’s largest glacier

  • Dinner and Overnight At your First-Class picturesque Hotel accommodation in South Iceland

Fosshotel Núpar or similar

Day9

Dyrhólaey – Skógafoss – Seljalandsfoss

  • Breakfast at the hotel

  • Visit the famous black sand beach at Reynisfjara and enjoy the coastal views from Dyrhólaey

  • Pass the glaciers of Mýrdalsjökull and the famous Eyjafjallajökull volcano

  • Discover Skógafoss, where water plunges 60 metres over ancient sea cliffs

  • Experience Seljalandsfoss, with the unique opportunity to walk behind the waterfall

  • Visit the Icelandic Lava Show, where you can safely witness real flowing lava up close

  • Dinner and Overnight At your First Class Hotel accommodation with a farewell Dinner in a Reykjavík hotel

Fosshotel Lind or similar

Day10

Departure – Keflavík airport

  • Breakfast at the hotel

  • Enjoy a private transfer to Keflavík International Airport for your departure flight
